This looks great — you've captured everything I raised. The automatic title and description with the ability to edit them, the read-later queue with an unread view, the formatted notes kept separate from the page's own description, the smarter search with tags and phrases and and/or/not, selecting a bunch at once to act on together, and archiving that I can undo versus a permanent delete that asks me to confirm — that's exactly what I had in mind. And I'm glad import and export are written down as coming later rather than forgotten.

I especially like the small touches you thought through, like not overwriting a title I've already edited when I change the address, and keeping a link's read-later state even while it's archived. Those are the kinds of things I would have been annoyed to lose.

I'm happy with this specification. Please go ahead and put together the implementation plan — I'll wait to see that before any code is written.
